query: UPDATE invoices i SET subtotal = s.total - s.tax, tax_amount = s.tax, total_amount = s.total, updated_at = now() FROM (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(line.tax), 0) AS tax, COALESCE(SUM(line.total), 0) AS total FROM (SELECT round(unit_price * SUM(quantity) * tax_percent / 100, 2) AS tax, SUM(total_price) AS total FROM invoice_items WHERE invoice_id = $1 AND tenant_id = $2 AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY COALESCE(reversal_of_id, id), unit_price, tax_percent) line) s WHERE i.id = $1 AND i.tenant_id = $2
